name: Programs
description: Programs in panes, as Remote Desktop's RemoteApp, opened three ways: Search finds a computer's installed programs by name as the Start menu does, Command runs a command line as Run does, and File opens a file or a folder picked from its folders with its program. This computer's from the home and Quick open, a computer you reach from its screen's menu; each is shown alone in a pane of its own (on Windows and in X11 sessions this computer's program is its own window, held in the pane).
